company.name: Zuma
company.shortDescription: Agentic AI for multifamily property management companies
company.description: Zuma AI is transforming multifamily operations with Kelsey, an agentic AI for your full resident lifecycle. Built for property managers and multifamily operators, Kelsey automates leasing, rent collections, voice AI workflows, and more. Leveraging a human-in-the-loop model, Kelsey captures leads, books tours, follows up with prospects, and supports residents in real time, 24/7/365. By eliminating busywork, Zuma empowers onsite teams to focus on hospitality, relationships, and community while helping operators boost occupancy, NOI, and resident satisfaction.

productsAndServices.description: An agentic AI platform for multifamily property managers that supports leasing, rent collections, move-outs, and resident communications across phone, text, email, and webchat.

productsAndServices.description: A customizable AI receptionist for multifamily properties that answers and manages property-related calls, provides information, and supports lead and resident workflows.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-supported move-out service that manages notices, final inspections, balance reconciliation, and security-deposit return tracking for multifamily properties.
productsAndServices.name: Move-out Workflow Automation
